description.value: Friend meetup at Bryant Park is an easy, free Midtown plan. The park sits between 40th and 42nd Streets and Fifth and Sixth Avenues behind the New York Public Library's Stephen A. Schwarzman building, and its October hours are Daily, 7am-10pm. Tripadvisor's listing (search snapshot) notes that The outdoor Reading Room has picture books and summertime story times, and in winter visitors can Take a spin on the free ice-skating rink. The park also has a landmarked comfort station with staffed public restrooms. Tripadvisor shows 4.6 of 5 bubbles (24,056 reviews) in the same snapshot. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “Fantastic place to visit around the Holidays.” Representative watch-outs: “Maybe the crowds, which are really heavy on the weekends.” and “the food here can be a bit overpriced”.
